title: Proactive Defense: Compound AI for Detecting Persuasion Attacks and Measuring Inoculation Effectiveness
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its findings focus on the performance of different LLMs in detecting various persuasion techniques, the effects of different prompting strategies, and the causal impact of these techniques on socio-emotional-cognitive measures.

measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure anything specific in terms of faith or religion. It measured the ability of large language models to detect 23 different types of persuasion techniques and the effectiveness of 'inoculation' strategies against these attacks.
